scope_boundary.purpose: Rebuild and PnP-start the locally test-signed WaveRT adapter in an isolated Hyper-V guest after correcting the WaveRT-to-topology bridge data ranges.
not_claimed: Microsoft signing or consumer release readiness

official_media.source: Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation 25H2 x64 EN-US

root_cause.cause: The WaveRT bridge pins advertised zero data ranges while their paired topology bridge pins advertised the analog audio range, so PortCls could not register the physical connection.
root_cause.correction: Use the same analog audio bridge range on both halves of each WaveRT/topology physical connection.

post_install_stable_restart.device_resolution: Root\HibikiDSP hardware ID resolved to an anonymous MEDIA-class instance token
post_install_stable_restart.problem_status_interpretation: The healthy device did not expose DEVPKEY_Device_ProblemStatus; Status=OK and ProblemCode=0 are the typed no-problem result.
post_install_stable_restart.setupapi_start_result: Device restart and related-driver installation exited successfully without a failed-start entry.

result.interpretation: The isolated guest proves package trust, installation, device creation, PortCls PnP start, and a running kernel service for this test build.

claims: Anonymous isolated-guest PnP-start evidence only. No physical-device control, playback/capture quality, real-time streaming, HLK, Microsoft signing, or release claim.
